08.09.2025 Produced At Annexure-F And Etc.,

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE K.S. HEMALEKHA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioner has approached this Court seeking for the following reliefs:-
a) Issue any suitable order, direction or writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent herein to consider the petitioner's representation dated 08.09.2025 produced at Annexure-F.
b) Issue any suitable order, direction or writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent herein to consider the case of the petitioner for grant of developed land in the industrial layout formed by acquiring the land of the petitioner, on the lines of the GO NC: 2025:KHC:50551 HC-KAR dated 23.02.2021 bearing No.103 SPQ (E) 2019 marked as Annexure-G.
c) Pass such other order, writ or direction as the Hon'ble Court deems fit in the facts and circumstances of the case including costs.
2. The petitioner claims to be the owner of the land bearing Survey No. 80 measuring 3 Acres 37 Guntas, situated at Arehalli Guddadahalli, Doddaballapura Taluk, Bengaluru Rural District.

The said property has been acquired for establishment of an industrial area pursuant to the preliminary notification under Section 28(1) followed by a Final Notification issued by the KIADB under Section 28(4) of the KIADB Act on 18.09.2002.

sentences.text:
The grievance of the petitioner is that though the representation has been submitted requesting allotment of a developed land in lieu of compensation the said representation has not been considered by the authorities, compelling him to approach this Court.
4.

Learned counsel Smt. Namitha.S on behalf of H.L. Pradeep Kumar submits that the representation of the NC: 2025:KHC:50551 HC-KAR petitioner shall be considered in accordance with law, within a time bound manner.

5. The said submission is recorded.
6. The grievance of the petitioner would stand redressed if necessary directions are issued to the respondent nos. 2 and 3.

Accordingly, this Court pass the following:-
ORDER 1. Writ petition is disposed of.
2. Respondent Nos.2 and 3 are directed to consider the petitioner's representation dated 08.09.2025 (at Annexure-F) and pass appropriate orders within (8 weeks)
from the date of receipt of the certified copy of this order.
